title: Marines save life on Mt. Fuji
description: U.S. Marine Cpls. Otto Thiele, Eric Goodman, and Christopher Ehms and Lance Cpls. Antonio Martinez and Avelardo Guevara Osuna came together to assist a local Japanese woman during their hike on Mt. Fuji, Japan, July 3, 2017. The woman, Oda Moe, was found lying on the ground and hyperventilating when the Marines came to her assistance. Together, they created a makeshift stretcher to carry her down the mountain, approximately two miles, to get medical assistance at a police station. The Marines are with Electronics Maintenance Company, 3rd Maintenance Battalion, Combat Logistics Regiment 35, 3rd Marine Logistics Group, III Marine Expeditionary Force.
